NASB.1: Now [David] built houses for himself in the city of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
NASB.2: Then David said, 'No one is to carry the ark of God but the Levites; for the LORD chose them to carry the ark of God and to minister to Him forever.'
NASB.3: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place which he had prepared for it.
NASB.4: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
NASB.5: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and 120 of his relatives;
NASB.6: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and 220 of his relatives;
NASB.7: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and 130 of his relatives;
NASB.8: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and 200 of his relatives;
NASB.9: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and 80 of his relatives;
NASB.10: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and 112 of his relatives.
NASB.11: Then David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel and Amminadab,
NASB.12: and said to them, 'You are the heads of the fathers' [households] of the Levites; consecrate yourselves both you and your relatives, that you may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to [the place] that I have prepared for it.
NASB.13: 'Because you did not [carry it] at the first, the LORD our God made an outburst on us, for we did not seek Him according to the ordinance.'
NASB.14: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
NASB.15: The sons of the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles thereon, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD.
NASB.16: Then David spoke to the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their relatives the singers, with instruments of music, harps, lyres, loud-sounding cymbals, to raise sounds of joy.
NASB.17: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel, and from his relatives, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and from the sons of Merari their relatives, Ethan the son of Kushaiah,
NASB.18: and with them their relatives of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.
NASB.19: So the singers, Heman, Asaph and Ethan [were appointed] to sound aloud cymbals of bronze;
NASB.20: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah and Benaiah, with harps [tuned] to alamoth;
NASB.21: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel and Azaziah, to lead with lyres tuned to the sheminith.
NASB.22: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was [in charge of] the singing; he gave instruction in singing because he was skillful.
NASB.23: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.
NASB.24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah also [were] gatekeepers for the ark.
NASB.25: So [it was] David, with the elders of Israel and the captains over thousands, who went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom with joy.
NASB.26: Because God was helping the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
NASB.27: Now David was clothed with a robe of fine linen with all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers and Chenaniah the leader of the singing [with] the singers. David also wore an ephod of linen.
NASB.28: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the horn, with trumpets, with loud-sounding cymbals, with harps and lyres.
NASB.29: It happened when the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David leaping and celebrating; and she despised him in her heart.

ESV.1: David  built houses for himself in the city of David. And he prepared a place for the ark of God and pitched a tent for it.
ESV.2: Then David said that no one but the Levites may carry the ark of God, for the LORD had chosen them to carry the ark of the LORD and to minister to him forever.
ESV.3: And David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place, which he had prepared for it.
ESV.4: And David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
ESV.5: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, with 120 of his brothers;
ESV.6: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, with 220 of his brothers;
ESV.7: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, with 130 of his brothers;
ESV.8: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, with 200 of his brothers;
ESV.9: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, with 80 of his brothers;
ESV.10: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, with 112 of his brothers.
ESV.11: Then David summoned the priests Zadok and Abiathar, and the Levites Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
ESV.12: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers' houses of the Levites. Consecrate yourselves, you and your brothers, so that you may bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place that I have prepared for it.
ESV.13: Because you did not carry it the first time, the LORD our God broke out against us, because we did not seek him according to the rule.”
ESV.14: So the priests and the Levites consecrated themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.
ESV.15: And the Levites carried the ark of God on their shoulders with the poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD.
ESV.16: David also commanded the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their brothers as the singers who should play loudly on musical instruments, on harps and lyres and cymbals, to raise sounds of joy.
ESV.17: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
ESV.18: and with them their brothers of the second order, Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
ESV.19: The singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were to sound bronze cymbals;
ESV.20: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth;
ESV.21: but Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith.
ESV.22: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, should direct the music, for he understood it.
ESV.23: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
ESV.24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, should blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
ESV.25: So David and the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom with rejoicing.
ESV.26: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
ESV.27: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as also were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers and Chenaniah the leader of the music of the singers. And David wore a linen ephod.
ESV.28: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, to the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, and made loud music on harps and lyres.
ESV.29: And as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out of the window and saw King David dancing and celebrating, and she despised him in her heart.

NKJV.1: David built houses for himself in the City of David; and he prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched a tent for it.
NKJV.2: Then David said, “No one may carry the ark of God but the Levites, for the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of God and to minister before Him forever.”
NKJV.3: And David gathered all Israel together at Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD to its place, which he had prepared for it.
NKJV.4: Then David assembled the children of Aaron and the Levites:
NKJV.5: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and one hundred and twenty of his brethren;
NKJV.6: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and two hundred and twenty of his brethren;
NKJV.7: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and one hundred and thirty of his brethren;
NKJV.8: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and two hundred of his brethren;
NKJV.9: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and eighty of his brethren;
NKJV.10: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and one hundred and twelve of his brethren.
NKJV.11: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
NKJV.12: He said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ houses of the Levites; sanctify yourselves, you and your brethren, that you may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel to the place I have prepared for it.
NKJV.13: For because you did not do it the first time, the LORD our God broke out against us, because we did not consult Him about the proper order.”
NKJV.14: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
NKJV.15: And the children of the Levites bore the ark of God on their shoulders, by its poles, as Moses had commanded according to the word of the LORD.
NKJV.16: Then David spoke to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers accompanied by instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, by raising the voice with resounding joy.
NKJV.17: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of their brethren, the sons of Merari, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
NKJV.18: and with them their brethren of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers;
NKJV.19: the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were to sound the cymbals of bronze;
NKJV.20: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with strings according to Alamoth;
NKJV.21: Mattithiah, Elipheleh, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, to direct with harps on the Sheminith;
NKJV.22: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites, was instructor in charge of the music, because he was skillful;
NKJV.23: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark;
NKJV.24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah, doorkeepers for the ark.
NKJV.25: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
NKJV.26: And so it was, when God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bulls and seven rams.
NKJV.27: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the music master with the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.
NKJV.28: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting and with the sound of the horn, with trumpets and with cymbals, making music with stringed instruments and harps.
NKJV.29: And it happened, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the City of David, that Michal, Saul’s daughter, looked through a window and saw King David whirling and playing music; and she despised him in her heart.

NLT.1: David now built several buildings for himself in the City of David. He also prepared a place for the Ark of God and set up a special tent for it.
NLT.2: Then he commanded, “No one except the Levites may carry the Ark of God. The LORD has chosen them to carry the Ark of the LORD and to serve him forever.”
NLT.3: Then David summoned all Israel to Jerusalem to bring the Ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.
NLT.4: This is the number of the descendants of Aaron (the priests) and the Levites who were called together:
NLT.5: From the clan of Kohath, 120, with Uriel as their leader.
NLT.6: From the clan of Merari, 220, with Asaiah as their leader.
NLT.7: From the clan of Gershon, 130, with Joel as their leader.
NLT.8: From the descendants of Elizaphan, 200, with Shemaiah as their leader.
NLT.9: From the descendants of Hebron, 80, with Eliel as their leader.
NLT.10: From the descendants of Uzziel, 112, with Amminadab as their leader.
NLT.11: Then David summoned the priests, Zadok and Abiathar, and these Levite leaders: Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab.
NLT.12: He said to them, “You are the leaders of the Levite families. You must purify yourselves and all your fellow Levites, so you can bring the Ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to the place I have prepared for it.
NLT.13: Because you Levites did not carry the Ark the first time, the anger of the LORD our God burst out against us. We failed to ask God how to move it properly.”
NLT.14: So the priests and the Levites purified themselves in order to bring the Ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, to Jerusalem.
NLT.15: Then the Levites carried the Ark of God on their shoulders with its carrying poles, just as the LORD had instructed Moses.
NLT.16: David also ordered the Levite leaders to appoint a choir of Levites who were singers and musicians to sing joyful songs to the accompaniment of harps, lyres, and cymbals.
NLT.17: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel along with his fellow Levites: Asaph son of Berekiah, and Ethan son of Kushaiah from the clan of Merari.
NLT.18: The following men were chosen as their assistants: Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers — Obed-edom and Jeiel.
NLT.19: The musicians Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were chosen to sound the bronze cymbals.
NLT.20: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were chosen to play the harps.
NLT.21: Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were chosen to play the lyres.
NLT.22: Kenaniah, the head Levite, was chosen as the choir leader because of his skill.
NLT.23: Berekiah and Elkanah were chosen to guard the Ark.
NLT.24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer — all of whom were priests — were chosen to blow the trumpets as they marched in front of the Ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah were chosen to guard the Ark.
NLT.25: Then David and the elders of Israel and the generals of the army went to the house of Obed-edom to bring the Ark of the LORD’s Covenant up to Jerusalem with a great celebration.

NRSVCE.16: David also commanded the chiefs of the Levites to appoint their kindred as the singers to play on musical instruments, on harps and lyres and cymbals, to raise loud sounds of joy.
NRSVCE.17: So the Levites appointed Heman son of Joel; and of his kindred Asaph son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari, their kindred, Ethan son of Kushaiah;
NRSVCE.18: and with them their kindred of the second order, Zechariah, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, and Mikneiah, and the gatekeepers Obed-edom and Jeiel.
NRSVCE.19: The singers Heman, Asaph, and Ethan were to sound bronze cymbals;
NRSVCE.20: Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah were to play harps according to Alamoth;
NRSVCE.21: but Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah were to lead with lyres according to the Sheminith.
NRSVCE.22: Chenaniah, leader of the Levites in music, was to direct the music, for he understood it.
NRSVCE.23: Berechiah and Elkanah were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
NRSVCE.24: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, were to blow the trumpets before the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah also were to be gatekeepers for the ark.
NRSVCE.25: So David and the elders of Israel, and the commanders of the thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom with rejoicing.
NRSVCE.26: And because God helped the Levites who were carrying the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
NRSVCE.27: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as also were all the Levites who were carrying the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the leader of the music of the singers; and David wore a linen ephod.
NRSVCE.28: So all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, to the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, and made loud music on harps and lyres.
NRSVCE.29: As the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, Michal daughter of Saul looked out of the window, and saw King David leaping and dancing; and she despised him in her heart.
